applied_rules.rationale: cLogP 3.5 at threshold with basic nitrogen present; however, hERG IC50 40 µM is well above the concern threshold (>10 µM), so the hERG check confirms safety. Rule condition met (cLogP borderline + basic N) but liability is mitigated by high IC50.
No structural alert present; rule applies only when alert is present. However, oncology context with BRAF V600E validation supports approval.
No aldehyde oxidase substrate identified in profile. Rule does not apply.
CYP3A4 time-dependent inhibition not flagged ('CYP clean'). Rule does not apply.
No PAINS alert present. Rule does not apply.

Candidate is cytotoxic by design (covalent kinase inhibitor for oncology) with high unmet need, but no structural alert of the type referenced in this rule is noted beyond the expected acrylamide warhead, which is mitigated. Rule context does not clearly apply in the override sense.
No evidence that candidate is an aldehyde oxidase substrate; GST conjugation is the documented clearance pathway. Rule does not apply.
Candidate is not a macrocyclic or PROTAC. Rule does not apply.
cLogP 3.2 does not exceed 3.5 threshold; no basic nitrogen structural feature noted in clinical notes. Rule condition not met.

Acrylamide (aldehyde-like reactive metabolite alert) is present, but glutathione conjugation mitigation is documented (12-min half-life, adequate daily turnover). Rule criterion is satisfied; candidate advances.
